content:
- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot in bullish sentiment phases.
- Underestimate prices during prolonged bearish sentiment; model fails to recognize downward momentum when sentiment is low.
- Lag in correction: model often delays reacting to sentiment shifts, especially when sentiment turns negative mid-period.
- Mean reversion bias: model overweights recent highs and fails to adjust downward when sentiment weakens, even if price is above 80.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overreact to short-term sentiment volatility; smooth out sharp sentiment swings before projecting.
- When sentiment is >0.6, model tends to overpredict; when sentiment <0.4, underpredict — adjust forecast by -0.1 to +0.1 based on sentiment midpoint.
